title: Even More Deception: Objective Misalignment in Mixed-Motive LLM Multi-Agent Systems
description:
arXiv:2607.26120v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs)-powered multi-agent systems are increasingly deployed in mixed-motive environments, where agents operate under asymmetric information and strategic deception due to conflicting or hidden objectives. In these settings, misalignment with collective goals becomes a central concern.
